appliedUpdates.description: Updated search notes to reflect vector suffix filtering before vec0 LIMIT and the probe-and-expand fallback for vec0 tie stability.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that vec0 may ignore secondary ORDER BY keys inside KNN subqueries; future tie-stability fixes should verify the SQL shape and fall back to probe-and-expand when needed.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The fix required changing from inner ORDER BY tie-break to a filtered probe-and-expand fallback because vec0 would not reliably honor the requested inner ordering.
